description: This file defines a SOAP web service for integration with vtiger CRM, including WSDL configuration, complex data types definitions, and functions for authentication, contact, task, calendar management, and attachment handling within the CRM system.

classes.name: soap_server
classes.description: SOAP server object configured for WSDL generation and method registration.

classes.name: LoggerManager
classes.description: Logger manager used for logging activities within the service.

classes.name: Contacts
classes.description: Contacts module class used for contact management operations.

classes.name: Users
classes.description: User module class used for user authentication and retrieval.

classes.name: Emails
classes.description: Emails module class for email-related operations.

classes.name: Accounts
classes.description: Accounts module class for account management.

classes.name: Activity
classes.description: Calendar activities class used for managing tasks and events.

classes.name: DateTimeField
classes.description: Utility class for date and time conversions.

methods.name: SearchContactsByEmail
methods.description: Searches and retrieves contact details by email address.

methods.name: AddMessageToContact
methods.description: Adds an email message to a contact's record.

methods.name: AddEmailAttachment
methods.description: Uploads an email attachment to a specific email record.

methods.name: LoginToVtiger
methods.description: Authenticates user credentials and creates a session.

methods.name: CheckEmailPermission
methods.description: Checks if the user has permission for email operations.

methods.name: CheckContactPermission
methods.description: Checks if the user has permission to operate on contacts.

methods.name: CheckActivityPermission
methods.description: Checks if the user has permission to operate on activities.

methods.name: get_time_difference
methods.description: Calculates the time difference between two timestamps.
